descriptions.before: Abstract base class for in-between interpolation handlers. Tween inherits from BaseTween.
descriptions.after: Abstract base class for in-between interpolation handlers. Tween inherits from TweenBase.

descriptions.before: PlaybackState describes the current stage for the Tween animation. A description of each state can be found on the page for the PlaybackState enum. It can be manipulated through other Tween functions, like Play.
descriptions.after: Read-only property that shows the current state for the Tween animation.

descriptions.before: The Cancel function halts playback of its Tween and resets the tween variables. If TweenBase:Play() is called again the Tween's properties will resume interpolating towards their destination but, as the tween variables have been reset, take the full length of the animation to do so.
descriptions.after: Halts playback and resets the tween variables. If you then call TweenBase:Play(), the properties of the tween resume interpolating towards their destination, but take the full length of the animation to do so.

descriptions.before: The Pause function halts playback of its Tween. If you call `Class.TweenBase.Play again, the tween resumes playback from the moment it was paused.
descriptions.after: Halts playback of the tween. Doesn't reset its progress variables, meaning that if you call TweenBase:Play(), the tween resumes playback from the moment it was paused.

descriptions.before: The Play function starts the playback of its Tween. Note that if a tween has already begun calling Play will have no effect unless the tween has finished or has been stopped (either by TweenBase:Cancel() or TweenBase:Pause()).
descriptions.after: Starts playback of a tween. Note that if playback has already started, calling Play() has no effect unless the tween has finished or is stopped (either by TweenBase:Cancel() or TweenBase:Pause()).

descriptions.before: The Completed event of a Tween fires when the tween finishes playing. This will happen either when the tween naturally finishes playing, or if it is stopped with TweenBase:Cancel().
descriptions.after: Fires when the tween finishes playing or when stopped with TweenBase:Cancel().

descriptions.before: Camera will zoom in until there is nothing between the player and camera.
descriptions.after: The camera zooms in until there is nothing between it and its subject.

descriptions.before: Any objects between the camera and player will become translucent locally.
descriptions.after: Any objects between the camera and its subject become translucent locally.

descriptions.before: The tween is beginning to play.
descriptions.after: The tween has been created, but has yet to be played. After exiting this state, the tween never enters it again.
The tween is waiting for the duration specified in its TweenInfo.DelayTime. After the delay elapses, the tween plays.
